name: App Requests
tagline: Ask. Vote. Watch it get built.
description:
App Requests is the community board for the apps and features you want on Civitai. Post an idea, up-vote the ones you want most, and watch what people care about rise to the top.

A request is a title plus optional details. As you type a title, the board surfaces requests that already look similar — up-voting one of those lifts it faster than splitting the vote across a near-duplicate. Your own posts stay yours: edit one in place to fix a typo or sharpen the idea without losing the votes it has already collected, or withdraw it, which removes the request and its votes for good.

Voting is one vote per person per request, and you can up-vote as many requests as you like. Click a vote again to take it back. Sort by Newest to see what just landed, or by Top to rank the board by votes. The team reviews the top requests.

Anyone can read the board signed out; posting and voting need a verified account at least seven days old and in good standing. Nothing here spends Buzz and nothing is generated — just ideas and votes. Posts are moderated, so keep it kind and constructive.

scopeJustifications.apps:storage:read: Reads the viewer's own per-user record of which requests they have up-voted, so their vote state stays consistent across sessions.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:write: Stores the viewer's own per-user record of which requests they have up-voted.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:read: Lists the shared board of app/feature requests visible to all users.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:write: Posts, edits, up-votes, and withdraws requests on the shared board visible to all users.
scopeJustifications.user:read:self: Reads the viewer's identity to attribute their own posts and gate author-only edit/withdraw.
